physical_due: start + chosen_duration - 1; next stage starts on the next tick
packet_due: sample_tick + 1 + chosen_latency; each stream is FIFO
device_hold: Check sustaining conditions before each physical phase, including before accepted is observed
terminal: All tasks settled and no scheduled physical event remains
query_time: Separate observation horizon, accepted-trigger cutoff and checked-until tail; no fault budget reset
scope: Versioned finite symbolic contract engine; no oracle or reference-engine imports; alignment claims require separate evidence
